title: Mattel Hot Wheels 2010 Ford Mustang GT '09 Auto Show Edition Car
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The Mattel Hot Wheels 2010 Ford Mustang GT '09 Auto Show Edition Car is a diecast toy vehicle in 1:64 scale, featuring the iconic Ford Mustang design. This red car is part of the Hot Wheels Racing series and is a collector's item for fans of contemporary manufactured cars. Made in Malaysia, this toy accurately represents the 2008 model year Ford Mustang GT, making it a desirable addition to any car enthusiast's collection.
